data.description: Add natural language support for sprint queries like 'what is in S-XXX', 'tasks in S-XXX', 'show sprint S-XXX'. Currently query language only supports task-related queries (what blocks, what depends on) but not sprint containment queries. The 'sprint tasks' command works but query language should also understand these patterns for consistency.

properties.retrospective: Added 3 new query patterns: 'what is in S-XXX', 'tasks in S-XXX', 'show sprint S-XXX'. Added 5 tests.

data.title: Enhance query language to support sprint queries
